title: Configure the insights blocklist-evidence webhook
description: Configure the CrowdSec notification plugin that pushes every ban decision to the nethesis-insights service.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the insights webhook.

base_url.description: Base URL of the nethesis-insights server that receives the decisions. Defaults to the production service when omitted.

verify_tls.description: Verify the server TLS certificate. Disable only when pointing at a self-signed test server.
